title: Geologic Map of the Surfside Beach Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Surfside Beach Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-166, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single map sheet read from OCR (page 1); most of the OCR text is map graphics. Map symbols are garbled or missing ('[ aFpas |', 'Pps') and were not recorded. The Water unit was not recorded. Legend-only features (contact, drill-hole symbol) were not recorded as values. Two thicknesses printed with '|' for a digit are read as 1, flagged inferred and sent to review. The OCR text ends at the scale bar; the base-map and datum block is not in it.
SUBSURFACE: margin elevations: Holocene terrace sediments below 10 ft landward; Princess Anne Formation above 12 ft seaward, below 18 ft landward; Pamlico Formation above 17 ft seaward, below 25 ft landward (page 1). Beach sand lies above mean low water up to the storm tide line (page 1). The legend shows SCGS drill-hole locations with log identification numbers (e.g. 26-332), logs on file at the SCGS and not in this document (page 1). No cross sections or structure contours appear in the OCR text. Datum: not stated in the OCR text.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; most of the OCR text is map graphics). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (OCR had them garbled or missing). Two thicknesses printed with '|' for a digit read as 1 (inferred). Margin elevations (Holocene terrace sediments <10 ft landward; Princess Anne Formation 12/18 ft; Pamlico Formation 17/25 ft, seaward/landward) recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed in the OCR text). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (26-3xx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Water unit and legend-only symbols not recorded.
